findings.title: The regression test does not request subgroup counts
findings.body: The four-argument `groups(null, 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE, true)` overload uses `true` for `briefRepresentation`; it does not enable the `subGroupsCount` query parameter. The production change is exclusively in `GroupAdapter.getSubGroupsCount()`, which is reached by `GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount` only when subgroup counts are requested. Consequently this test can pass without executing the fixed code path or reproducing the original NPE. Invoke the endpoint overload/query option with `subGroupsCount=true` while the deletes run.

findings.title: The concurrent reader is not awaited before asserting its failures
findings.body: After setting `deletedAll`, the test immediately asserts that `caughtExceptions` is empty without joining or otherwise waiting for the reader thread. A request already in progress can fail and add an exception after this assertion, and the reader may not have been scheduled at all before deletion completes. This makes the test capable of passing without exercising concurrency and leaves a background thread running into later test activity. Keep the thread/future and await its completion (and preferably use a latch to confirm at least one read overlaps deletion) before checking the collected exceptions.
